title: neptune-fork: Le Verrier's 1846 prediction of Neptune, rebuilt as a calibrated Bayesian inference
description:
Rebuilds Le Verrier's 1846 inference of Neptune from Uranus's motion from first principles: an own Wisdom–Holman N-body integrator validated against REBOUND, Uranus's orbit always fitted jointly with an unseen perturber, partitioned nested sampling (dynesty) for multimodal posteriors and evidence, and coverage tests on synthetic data.

Includes a double-entry transcription of Le Verrier's 1846 Table n° 77 (279 observations) with a resolution log and misprint table, and an apparent-place observation model with per-observer error calibration.

So far, synthetic-data results only.
